result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.find_edge_ids()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 toc-depth: 3 page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Find edge IDs between two nodes. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L5230-L5272){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.find_edge_ids( source, target, ) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} ![Find edge ids](/assets/graphs/find-edge-ids.light.svg){.lightbox fig-alt="The shared four-node graph with a second, parallel edge between A and B. The query nodes A and B are outlined in the accent color, and both edges between them, ids 1 and 6, are highlighted. The card returns 1 and 6." width="100%"} Returns a list of all edge IDs connecting the source and target nodes. For undirected graphs, edges are found regardless of direction. Supports multi-edges (multiple edges between the same pair of nodes). ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [source]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Union[int, str]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Source node ID or label. [target]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Union[int, str]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Target node ID or label. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [list[int]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : List of edge IDs. Empty list if no edges exist. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Because multigraphs allow more than one edge between the same pair of nodes, `find_edge_ids()` returns every match rather than just the first: ::: {#e1d7aef5 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ec.Graph() graph.add_node(label="A") graph.add_node(label="B") graph.add_edge(source="A", target="B") graph.add_edge(source="A", target="B") # a second, parallel edge graph.find_edge_ids(source="A", target="B") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` [1, 2] ``` ::: :::
